title: {{name}}'s growth
needDob: Add {{name}}'s date of birth in the family profile to see growth charts.
viewerNotice: Growth details are visible to parents and caregivers only.

status.pending: Saved. The percentile appears once the device is online.
status.steady: {{name}} is growing along their own curve.
status.remeasure: A recent value looks unusual. A quick re-measure helps.
status.watch: Worth a closer look at the next check-up.
status.red_flag: Please book a visit with {{name}}'s doctor.

offline: Saved on this device. It will sync when you are online.
empty: Measure {{name}} at home and add the first values here.

upsell.title: See the full growth chart
upsell.body: Premium shows the WHO percentile chart with reference lines and the full history.

noPoints: No calculated points yet for this chart.
bandsNote: Lines show the 3rd, 15th, 50th, 85th and 97th percentiles. Each child follows their own curve.
excluded: Not shown on the chart (please re-measure)
disclaimer: Growth charts support, and never replace, your child's doctor.

alert.pausedBody: New growth plans for {{name}} wait until a doctor has seen them. Everyday family meals stay the same.
alert.watchTitle: Something to mention at the next check-up
alert.whatToDo: Bring this chart to the appointment. It is nobody's fault, and a doctor can help work out what is going on.

codes.weight_for_age_below_p3: {{name}}'s weight is below the 3rd percentile for age.
codes.crossed_two_major_percentiles: {{name}}'s weight has crossed two major percentile lines.
codes.bmi_for_age_above_p97: {{name}}'s BMI for age is above the 97th percentile. Keep family habits calm and talk to a doctor; no dieting for children.
codes.height_for_age_below_p3: {{name}}'s height is below the 3rd percentile for age.
codes.severe_thinness: {{name}}'s BMI for age is very low.
codes.head_circumference_out_of_range: {{name}}'s head measurement is outside the usual range. Mention it at the next check-up.
codes.implausible_measurement: One of {{name}}'s measurements looks unlikely, so it is left off the chart. Please measure again.

add.title: Measure {{name}}
add.head: Head circumference
add.headHint: Optional, around the widest part of the head.
add.offlineNote: Saves on this device first, so it works offline.

check.height_decrease: Height is lower than last time. Measuring again often helps.
check.weight_jump: Weight changed a lot in a month. Measuring again often helps.

errors.date_future: The date can't be in the future.
errors.date_before_birth: The date can't be before the date of birth.
errors.height_range: Enter a height between 30 and 220 cm.
errors.weight_range: Enter a weight between 1 and 200 kg.
errors.head_range: Enter a head size between 25 and 60 cm.
